functions.name: ActivateHouseEditorMode
documentation: Attempts switch the House Editor to a specific House Editor mode

returns.name: result
documentation: The initial result of the attempt to activate the mode; If Success, mode is either already active, or we've succesfully started making required requests to server; Listen for MODE_CHANGED or MODE_CHANGE_FAILURE events for ultimate end result after server calls

functions.name: EnterHouseEditor
documentation: Attempts to open the House Editor to the default House Editor mode

returns.name: result
documentation: The initial result of the attempt to open the Editor; If Success, Editor is either already active, or we've succesfully started making required requests to server; Listen for MODE_CHANGED or MODE_CHANGE_FAILURE events for ultimate end result after server calls

functions.name: GetHouseEditorAvailability
documentation: Returns the availability state of the House Editor overall

functions.name: GetHouseEditorModeAvailability
documentation: Returns the availability of a specific House Editor mode

functions.name: IsHouseEditorActive
documentation: Returns whether the House Editor is active, in any mode

functions.name: IsHouseEditorModeActive
documentation: Returns whether the specific House Editor mode is active

functions.name: IsHouseEditorStatusAvailable
documentation: Returns true if the HouseEditor currently able process mode availability and switching; May be false if not in a house or plot, or while waiting to get house settings back from the server

fields.name: None
documentation: Not in a house or plot, or at one without even sufficient visiting permissions

fields.name: Owner
documentation: Owner of the current house or plot

fields.name: Visitor
documentation: A visitor of the current house or plot
